# {{ company.name }}

> {{ company.name }} is {{ company.slogan | downcase }} based in {{ company.locality }}, {{ company.region }}, USA. It designs, assembles, and supports aviation headset adapters that connect general aviation (GA) pilot headsets to computers and tablets for flight simulation, a PCB for wiring headset jacks into real aircraft panels, and a free desktop app (USB2x Toolbar) for sidetone and VOX.

- Founded by {{ site.staff_members | map: "name" | join: " and " }}; every adapter is assembled, tested, and packaged in {{ company.locality }}, {{ company.region }}.
- Contact: {{ company.email }} or {{ "/contact/" | absolute_url }}
- Full details (specifications and every FAQ answer in one file): {{ "/llms-full.txt" | absolute_url }}

### USB2x Toolbar (free app)

Free desktop app for USB2GA and USB2Lemo: sidetone (hear your own voice), voice-activated VOX, and input/output level control. macOS (Universal) and Windows 10/11. Current version {{ site.data.toolbar.version }}.

- Download page: {{ "/downloads/toolbar/" | absolute_url }}
- Microsoft Store: {{ site.data.toolbar.windows.store_url }}
- Release notes: {{ "/downloads/toolbar/changelog/" | absolute_url }}
